{{Recipe}}

One recipe for the production of '''snickerdoodle cookies''' is as follows.

== Ingredients ==

* 344 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] (2 ¾ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] or 24 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) [[Cookbook:Flour|all-purpose flour]]
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 1 tsp [[Cookbook:Baking Soda|baking soda]]
* 2 tsp [[Cookbook:Cream of Tartar|cream of tartar]]
* 200 g (1 cups or 6 oz) [[Cookbook:Castor sugar|white sugar]]
* 100 g (½ cup or 4 oz) [[Cookbook:Shortening|soft shortening]]
* 110 g (½ cup or 4 oz) butter
* 2 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]], beaten
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] sugar
* 1 tsp [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]]

== Procedure ==

# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to [[Cookbook:Oven temperatures|205°C (400°F or Gas Mark 6).]]
# Mix flour, salt, baking soda, cream of tartar, sugar, shortening, and butter.
# Roll into 1 tbsp balls.
# Mix sugar and cinnamon.
# Roll balls in sugar-cinnamon mixture.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for 10 minutes or until crisp and light brown.
# Sprinkle generously with cinnamon while hot.

== Notes, tips, variations ==

* Other recipes add [[Cookbook:Honey|honey]] to the dough, which helps to keep the cookies from becoming too crisp.
